title: Browser Probe: let Claude actually look at your web app
summary: Claude drives a real headless Chrome so it can screenshot every screen of your web app, catch JavaScript errors, and spot bugs that only show up on screen. No Playwright or Puppeteer needed.
how_to_use: Install it, then ask Claude: "test the UI", "screenshot every screen at phone size" or "it looks wrong but the data is fine, find out why".
requires: Google Chrome and Node 22 or newer.
